digest.component_or_area: rebar link command and caused_by relation validation
propositions: The caused_by link type accepts any target without validating that the target has an associated referencing commit, allowing misattributions to be recorded in the store
The referencing_commits scan exists only in close_precheck._referencing_commits as a private function and must be hoisted into commit_impact.py as a shared, reusable implementation
A caused_by link to a target with no referencing commits must be rejected by link_core and _link_dry_run identically across CLI, library, and MCP interfaces unless overridden by --force
The refusal logic must distinguish between unverifiable targets (no code repo or no git history, which allow the link) and targets provably lacking commits (which refuse unless forced)
Both link_core (write path) and _link_dry_run (preview path) must call a shared caused_by_refusal predicate to prevent the preview and actual behavior from diverging
The --force escape hatch with optional reason must be implemented once in extract_force and reused by both claim and link commands
